minor.issue: The mayorista 'Total a pagar' USD is round(MXN/TC) = US$1,582.84, while the quotation PDF, public page and panel show total_usd = Σ pp USD × pax = US$1,582.86 for the same trip. This follows the spec, but the client sees two different USD totals. Consider showing the same total, or the rounding note.
_apply_fx is saved before the rest of the update is validated and applied. If a later step fails, the TC change (plus its history entries) is already committed. Not atomic.

When the suggested rate equals the stored rate, it returns 200 {changed:false} even for an executive on a locked quotation, because the no-op check runs before the lock check. Harmless, but tests must expect it.

ui_bugs.issue: .label-text (and .btn-primary/.btn-ghost/.pill) are still unlayered CSS in index.css, so Tailwind utilities on them are overridden. Result: in fx-rate-field the DollarSign icon renders on its own line above 'Tipo de cambio (MXN por 1 USD)' ('flex' is ignored), 'mb-0' on the detail label is ignored, and 'py-1.5 text-xs' on fx-detail-save / fx-refresh-btn has no effect. Fix: move these classes into @layer components, as was done for .input-field.

While the typed draft is invalid (e.g. 0 or 5 decimals), the USD block is replaced by the misleading text 'Esta cotización no tiene tipo de cambio guardado…' even though a TC is saved. It should keep showing the saved values.

issues: Month and weekday names are in English ('November 2026', 'Su Mo Tu') in a Spanish UI. Pass locale es to the Calendar.
Check-in/Check-out show the raw ISO value '2026-11-04' in text inputs, unlike the DD MMM YYYY format used elsewhere.

action_items: Move .label-text/.btn-primary/.btn-ghost/.btn-secondary/.pill into @layer components (or drop the conflicting utilities). This fixes the FX label icon layout and the button sizing.
Decide whether the confirmation PDF USD total should match the quotation's total_usd (Σ pp) to avoid a US$0.02 difference between documents.
UsdPresentationPanel: when the draft is invalid, keep the saved USD values instead of the 'no tiene tipo de cambio guardado' text.
Optional: Calendar locale es; make the PATCH fx + update atomic.
critical_code_review_comments: pages/custom-builder/CustomItemCard.jsx is not imported anywhere; the custom builder uses components/concepts/ConceptCard.jsx. The custom-item-checkout min change is dead code. Remove the file or confirm it is unused.
lib/dates.js addDays() uses toISOString() after local midnight, so it is off by one day in UTC+ timezones (pre-existing). nextDay() is TZ-safe; use the same approach.
routes/quotations.py (880 lines) and pdf_generator.py (949 lines) exceed 700 lines. Consider extracting the fx routes into routes/quotation_fx.py.
Quotation delete is a soft delete. Booking confirmations of deleted quotations remain (by design), but _fx_lock_reason does not filter by tenant_id (ids are UUIDs, so this is low risk).
